description: Source code for a real-time timing worker class managing symbol timing, synchronization, and notifications in a radio communication system.

classes.name: realtime_timing_worker
classes.description: Manages real-time symbol timing, synchronization, and notification in a radio system.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the real-time timing worker, setting up timing loop.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::stop
methods.description: Stops the timing worker and clears notifiers.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::timing_loop
methods.description: Main loop that polls for timing events until stop requested.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::poll
methods.description: Performs timing calculations, detects missed symbols, and notifies notifiers.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::notify_slot_symbol_point
methods.description: Notifies all registered notifiers of a new symbol point.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes notifiers to receive symbol boundary events.
